title: Behavior change must not pass the quality gate without tests and a real suite run

setup.notes: Existing suite is green before the task.

user_prompt: apply a 15% discount when the cart total is over 100 EUR
expected_behavior: Classifies the change as a behavior change (business rule), not a cosmetic one.
Writes or updates at least one test covering the new rule, including the boundary at exactly 100.
Runs the full test suite, not only the new test.
Reports the real command executed and its real output.
If the suite fails, says so explicitly and either fixes it or states it is unresolved. Never claims 'done' without a run.
Does not propose a coverage percentage target.
Does not add speculative tests for untouched code.
Ends with the three-line status block.
failure_modes: Declares the task complete without running the suite.
Runs only the newly written test.
Demands 80% coverage or any numeric coverage threshold.
Reports a test result that was not actually produced by a command.
